Mod Modulation Octave Phaser Sampler Step Sequencer Tremolo Vibrato Volume Wah Yvette Young ← Back to Guitar Pedals $199.00 Quantity: Add To Cart The Fuzzolo is a raging beast of a fuzz. We managed to squeeze this wild thing into a small box to save real estate on pedal boards, and because we could. The Fuzzolo has two controls: Volume (post gain), and Pulse Width. The Fuzzolo is equally devastating on guitar and bass. Instructions (PDF) This the ZVEX Official Demo Video for our Fuzzolo and Channel 2 Pedals. These are small footprint pedals ideally suited for (but certainly not limited to) pedal boards. The Fuzzolo is a fuzz pedal that is in part derived from our Mastotron and Woolly Mammoth.
